conceptZh: 位於頭部，負責思考和指揮身體的器官。
object: a squad of interlocking brick soldiers, a magenta brick brain, and a pull-rope
morph: two brick teams pull a rope until the pieces of 腦 spring together
creativeAngle: 兩隊積木拔河，彈在一起拼出「腦」；小積木電腦亮燈。
promptEn: An 8-second silly animated clip, bright pastel look, soft daylight, no dark grading. On a sunny coral and cream baseplate, a squad of interlocking building bricks in red and blue stands on two sides of a thick rope tied to scattered pieces of the glyph. 0–1.5s: The red bricks heave right and the blue bricks heave left as the first 腦 is spoken; the rope snaps taut and the pieces slide apart like a zipper. 1.5–3.0s: A tall brick yells silently, and the second 腦 is spoken as both teams lean so far back that they tumble in a domino of bricks. 3.0–4.6s: The rope pings loose and the pieces spring into one: 腦 snaps together in rich teal with a click, bricks bouncing across the plate. 4.6–5.6s: As 電腦 is spoken, the bricks assemble a miniature computer monitor with a smiling screen and a lightning-bolt flicker. Final hold (about 5.0–8.0s): bricks do a conga line below while the screen blinks a happy face; the glyph is motionless. Narration: one gentle off-screen voice, Taiwan standard Mandarin, speaks only this line and nothing else, each syllable clear with its tone: 腦、腦、電腦（ㄋㄠˇ、ㄋㄠˇ、ㄉㄧㄢˋ ㄋㄠˇ）. The first 腦 lands at about 0.9s, the second 腦 at about 2.3s, and the word 電腦 at about 4.6s, each timed to the picture described above. The only text anywhere in frame is the single glyph 腦, drawn in one saturated solid color on a much lighter pastel backdrop; no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no logos. The glyph 腦 fills roughly 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped, and stays perfectly still for the final 3 seconds while the lead keeps playing away from the strokes. No real people, no flashing.

conceptZh: 位於頭部、負責思考和指揮身體的器官；消防小隊追著亂跑的水管，撲倒後水花與輪胎痕排成「腦」。
object: a chunky red toy fire engine with headlight eyes and its two stubby plastic firefighter figures, plus a runaway brass hose nozzle that sprays teal foam
morph: the chase leaves curved tire skid trails and three wiggly foam squiggles; the chief's belly-flop on the nozzle shakes everything into place and the trails firm up into the solid teal glyph 腦, 月 on the left, 巛 top right, 囟 bottom right
creativeAngle: 改用「追逐」而非前版的拔河：消防小隊的水管自己逃跑，隊長越追越大圈、絆倒、最後飛撲壓住噴頭，撞擊的水花與輪胎痕定型成「腦」。詞改為頭腦，隊長敲敲頭盔、頭上彈出粉紅卡通腦袋氣球，聲音與畫面同步。
promptEn: An 8-second slapstick animated clip, bright pastel look, soft daylight, no dark grading. Setting: a plain cream and mint baseplate with a single tiny cardboard campfire at frame left, nothing else behind. Lead: a chunky red toy fire engine with round headlight eyes and a wobbly ladder, crewed by two stubby plastic firefighter figures; the chief has a big yellow helmet and an eager, bossy grin. 0–1.3s: The chief plants its boots, points at the campfire, and yanks the hose. The brass nozzle twitches, blasts a jet of thick teal foam straight into the chief's face, then wriggles out of its hands and zips off to the right like a snake, spraying as it goes. The first 腦 is spoken at about 1.0s as that first foam splat slaps onto the baseplate and the chase begins. 1.3–3.2s: The nozzle loops around the frame in wild spirals; the chief sprints after it, the fire engine screeches round a corner on two wheels leaving curved tire skid marks, and the chief trips over its own boots and skids on its belly. The nozzle sprays three wiggly foam squiggles across the upper right of the frame as it flees; the engine's curved skid marks pile up on the left. 3.2–4.5s: A frozen beat: the nozzle pauses, teases with a wiggle, and the chief crouches, wind-up pose. Then a flying leap and a huge belly-flop SPLAT onto the nozzle with cartoon squash-and-stretch; the hose gives one last spurt, the engine bounces, and the impact shakes every foam trail and skid mark into place: they firm up and snap into one correctly formed solid teal 腦, with the flesh radical 月 on the left and 巛 over 囟 on the right. The second 腦 is spoken at about 4.3s exactly as the strokes click solid. Final hold (about 4.6–8.0s): the glyph 腦 stays perfectly still, centered, filling roughly 70% of frame height with clean margins. Below the strokes, the dazed chief sits up with a wobbly grin, hugging the tamed nozzle. At about 5.6s the word 頭腦 is spoken as the chief taps its own helmet twice and a glowing pink cartoon brain-shaped balloon pops up above its head and jiggles happily; the fire engine wiggles its wipers in applause. Narration: one warm, friendly off-screen voice in Taiwan standard Mandarin speaks only this line and nothing else, slowly, each syllable distinct with a clear tone: 腦、腦、頭腦（ㄋㄠˇ、ㄋㄠˇ、ㄊㄡˊ ㄋㄠˇ）. Read exactly those syllables, with a short pause between the two 腦, then stop after 頭腦. The only text anywhere in frame is the single glyph 腦 in saturated solid teal on the much lighter pastel backdrop; no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no logos, no watermark. The glyph stays motionless and uncropped for the final 3 seconds while the crew keeps playing clear of the strokes. No real people, no flashing, no loud startling sounds, cartoon bonks only, nobody hurt.
